subject: [RFC PATCH v2 10/18] mm: have folio_mark_accessed() return whether the folio is hot

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the `folio_mark_accessed` function to return a boolean value indicating whether the accessed folio is considered 'hot'. A hot folio is one that is either unevictable or has its access flags set. This change prepares for reading the status of folios without requiring an explicit reference to them. The patch updates the `folio_mark_accessed` function and related code in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module.
